landing.title: PbtA Sheets
landing.lede: Character sheets you can actually play from — the whole sheet on a phone, so nobody has to pass the book around the table.
landing.note: Currently Monsterhearts 2. Ten skins, all of them trouble.

home.title: Your Table
home.charactersEmpty: No characters yet. Pick a skin and find out what kind of monster you are.
home.seasonsLede: A season is your group. Share its code and everyone's Strings can point at real characters instead of typed names.
home.characterCount: {count, plural, =0 {no characters} one {1 character} other {# characters}}

picker.title: Choose a Skin
picker.lede: Every skin is a different way of being a monster, and a different way of being a teenager. Pick the one that sounds like trouble.
picker.footnote: Ten core skins. The Chosen and the Serpentine aren't in the free reference set — they need the book.
